label: Bonn Challenge Pledges
contestNote: Pledges cover commitments from 70+ countries but actual restoration delivery is estimated at ~50 million ha — a 76% implementation gap.

label: Great Green Wall Completion
contestNote: UNCCD/AFR100 estimate ~30M ha restored (30% of 100M ha target) as of 2024; independent WRI verified analysis puts credible native restoration closer to 4–8%. Financing gap remains acute: only ~15% of $19B pledged disbursed. Conflict in Mali, Burkina Faso, and Sudan blocks implementation across major GGW corridor zones.

label: UN Decade Restoration Target
source: UNEP / UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration (2021–2030)
contestNote: Official UNEP target; mid-decade progress estimated at ~300–500 million ha under varying forms of restoration commitment.

label: Trees Committed (1t.org)
contestNote: Covers pledges from 90+ countries and 80+ companies; survival and biodiversity quality of planted trees remain largely unverified at scale.

label: Annual Net Forest Loss
source: FAO Global Forest Resources Assessment 2020 / Global Forest Watch (2023)
contestNote: FAO net figure masks gross deforestation of ~10 M ha/yr offset by plantation gains; primary old-growth loss far exceeds new-growth recovery in biodiversity value.

label: Global Mangrove Coverage
source: Science / Tulane University (Zhang & Friess, June 2026); Global Mangrove Alliance / JAXA (2023)
contestNote: Landmark Tulane/Science study (June 2026) found global mangroves have reversed decades of decline: net gains since 2010 outpace losses, 40-year net loss reduced to ~1% (from ~2,900 km² lost 1980–2010). Recovery driven by natural regeneration on abandoned aquaculture, conservation policies, and climate-driven northward expansion. West/Central Africa remains a net loss region.
deltaNote: 40-yr net loss now ~1% — first confirmed global reversal (Science, June 2026)

label: AFR100 Pledges (Africa)
contestNote: Commitments from 34 African countries; IUCN Barometer shows delivery significantly lagging behind pledges in most participating nations.

label: Amazon Deforestation (Brazil, 12-mo. Aug'25–Jul'26)
source: INPE DETER alerts (Aug 9, 2026); INPE PRODES (July 10, 2026); WRI/Univ. of Maryland GLAD Lab (April 2026)
contestNote: Lowest annual deforestation-alert total since 2013 (down 36% y/y, 55.6% below the prior decade's average) — extends the decline reported in the July 10 PRODES half-year figure (1,295 km², Jan–Jun 2026, -38% y/y). Improvement attributed to the relaunched PPCDAm plan and stepped-up IBAMA enforcement. However, forest degradation (illegal logging, wildfires, drought) affects an estimated 40% of remaining forest — not captured in deforestation-alert metrics.

label: Ethiopia Green Legacy — Cumulative Trees Planted
source: Government of Ethiopia / Green Legacy Initiative (Aug 3, 2026)
contestNote: Includes a record 800 million seedlings planted in a single day on Aug 3, 2026 (22.2M participants) toward an 8 billion seedling target for 2026 and an eventual 50–65 billion goal. Government claims 79–83% survival rates, but independent researchers note no publicly available site-level surveys exist to verify planting locations or nationwide survival; global studies show roughly half of mass-planted seedlings die within 5 years.
